message_bubble.chaining_rule: consecutive messages from the same sender: the corner on the sender side next to the neighbour becomes 4 px (top when chained to previous, bottom when chained to next)
message_bubble.shadow: two fills of the bubble path offset 2 px and 1 px down, rgba(0,0,0,0.01) and rgba(0,0,0,0.08), clipped to the bottom 12 px; no shadow on incoming bubbles when a wallpaper needs a border (then 1 px ghost_secondary border)

animations.what: Recents column width change (mini mode / spread)
Pending clock shown only if send takes longer than
Hover controls on message (share button) shift 8 px
Input height change / side buttons / button swap (send vs voice)

items.plays_when: an incoming message notification is shown (TrayIcon::showMessage), if 'Play sounds' is on; at most once per 3 s; never during a call or while another sound plays; muted by macOS Do Not Disturb
items.note: two-syllable envelope matches the 2001b Message.wav ('uh-oh'), Inference

items.plays_when: a new message is sent (not on edit), only if 'Outgoing messages sound' is on (default off)
new email alert (Mail.ru mail integration); not relevant for a rebuild
voice message recording starts; recording begins after the sound
voice recording reaches the 15 minute limit

items.file: inside the proprietary voip library (core/Voip/call_*.h headers reference dial, busy, connected, end)
items.plays_when: outgoing ringback, busy, connected, hang up

sounds.note: All six WAVs are byte-identical in the 23.2.0 Windows build (installer fork, scratchpad win-icqexe-wav/).

behaviour.close_button: hides to tray on all platforms; quit via tray menu
behaviour.read_status: sent = one check, delivered = two checks (base_primary), read = small avatars (16 px) of readers under the last read message; pending clock only after 500 ms
behaviour.edit_rule: own outgoing messages, or admin in channels; no client time limit (server limit Unknown)
behaviour.delete_rule: 'Delete for me' always; 'Delete for all' for own messages or admins; Favorites uses 'Delete'

roles.readonly: read only (channel subscriber or banned to write)

behaviour.double_click_message: quotes the message into the input (ComplexMessageItem.cpp mouseDoubleClickEvent)
behaviour.lock_shortcut: Ctrl+L / Cmd+L when local passcode is on (MainWindow.cpp:2283)
